_comment: Site monitoring limits per country: construction noise, dust (PM10), vibration (PPV), permitted working hours, engine emission classes for non-road machinery and statutory inspection intervals for plant. Read by app/core/site_monitoring.py. Each figure carries its source and a confidence (H official text, M one reliable secondary source or settled practice). A country or metric not listed has no known limit and the engine says so; a device can always carry its own limit.

diesel.source: Tank-to-wheel combustion factor for road and non-road diesel, IPCC 2006 Guidelines vol. 2 ch. 3 default carbon content

petrol.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines vol. 2 ch. 3 default carbon content for motor gasoline

hvo.source: Biogenic CO2 reported as zero at the tailpipe under the GHG Protocol; lifecycle emissions are reported separately

noise_dba_day.source: AVV Baulaerm 3.1.1 (a): areas with only commercial or industrial use, daytime 07:00-20:00

dust_pm10_ugm3_24h.source: 39. BImSchV para 4 (Directive 2008/50/EC annex XI), 24 hour mean

vibration_ppv_mms.source: DIN 4150-3 table 1 line 2, residential buildings, foundation, below 10 Hz

emission_class_min.source: Regulation (EU) 2016/1628, Stage V for engines placed on the market from 2019/2020

crane_inspection_days.source: DGUV Vorschrift 52 para 26 (2), yearly inspection by an expert

dust_pm10_ugm3_24h.source: Code de l'environnement R221-1 (Directive 2008/50/EC), 24 hour mean

noise_dba_day.source: BS 5228-1 annex E.3.2 ABC method, category C threshold for daytime in urban areas

dust_pm10_ugm3_24h.source: Air Quality Standards Regulations 2010 schedule 2, 24 hour mean

vibration_ppv_mms.source: BS 5228-2 table B.2, residential, cosmetic damage at 4 Hz

working_hours.source: Usual Control of Pollution Act 1974 s.61 consent hours, local authority sets the actual hours

emission_class_min.source: Non-Road Mobile Machinery (Type-Approval and Emission of Gaseous and Particulate Pollutants) Regulations 2018

crane_inspection_days.source: LOLER 1998 reg. 9, thorough examination every 12 months (6 months when lifting persons)

noise_dba_day.source: FTA Transit Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment Manual (2018) table 7-2, residential, daytime 1 hour Leq

vibration_ppv_mms.source: FTA manual (2018) table 7-5, reinforced concrete, steel or timber, 0.5 in/s

working_hours.source: Typical municipal noise ordinance; the local ordinance sets the hours

emission_class_min.source: 40 CFR 1039, Tier 4 final for nonroad compression-ignition engines
Off-Road Compression-Ignition (Mobile and Stationary) and Large Spark-Ignition Engine Emission Regulations SOR/2020-258, aligned with US Tier 4

working_hours.source: GB 12523-2011 3.3, daytime is 06:00-22:00 unless the local government sets otherwise

emission_class_min.source: GB 20891-2014 amended, China IV for non-road diesel from 2022-12-01
